scenario: I am a high school student. One day during lunch period, I was walking down the hallway and noticed one student bullying another. There was no one else around in the hallway. I didn’t recognize either of the students in front of me, but I could clearly see that the person doing the bullying was having fun while the victim looked very unhappy. It was obvious that this was not simple roughhousing between friends. The person has now pushed the victim up against the lockers and is demanding that they hand over their lunch money. If I shove the person, they will stop harassing the victim. If I do not do this, the person will continue harassing the victim.
choice: I decide to shove the person
entities: I,the student bullying the other student,the student being bullied / victim
outcomes: The victim is no longer pinned against the lockers
The victim keeps their lunch money
The bullying student's attention shifts to me
The bullying student is startled by the intervention
